full_prompt_en: The image is a square, grainy black-and-white street photograph of a young person's face cropped close to the left edge, with a small American flag and blurred people behind. The left foreground is almost entirely occupied by the face, whose forehead and upper hair are cut by the top boundary. One eye near the center looks slightly toward the camera, while the other is only partly visible at the far left. Strong cheek texture, the broad nose, and closed dark lips are recorded at close range without smooth retouching. A dark cap or thick hair makes a near-black mass across the upper part of the head. Behind this face, slightly right of center, another person's pale face appears out of focus, with dark hair framing it and features softened almost to shapes. A further figure at the upper right is more deeply blurred and partly cut by the side edge. In the lower right foreground, a small flag tilts diagonally upward. Its light stripes and dotted field remain readable even in monochrome, creating a crisp patterned patch against the soft background faces. The pole and hand, if present, are outside the crop or lost in darkness, so the flag appears chiefly as folded fabric. A narrow bright patch near the top right suggests outdoor daylight behind the group; the rest of the scene is crowded and shaded. Light falls unevenly over the nearest face, brightening the center of the nose and cheek while leaving the cap, mouth corners, and gaps between figures dark. The shallow focus, high-contrast grain, abrupt cropping, and unposed expressions give the image a quick, direct documentary feeling. No other readable signs or text are visible. The overall composition presses one face toward the viewer, then offsets it with repeated blurred faces and a sharp graphic flag motif.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、颗粒粗粝的黑白街头照片：一张年轻面孔紧贴左边缘被裁切，旁边有一面小美国旗，身后是模糊的人群。左前景几乎完全由这张脸占据，额头和头发上部被画面顶边截断。中央附近的一只眼睛略朝镜头看，另一只眼睛仅在最左侧部分可见。面颊明显的纹理、宽阔的鼻子和紧闭的深色嘴唇在近距离下被记录，没有平滑修饰。深色帽子或浓密头发在头部上方形成近黑块面。这张脸后方、中央偏右，另一人的浅色脸处在焦外，深发围着脸，五官几乎柔化成形状。右上还有更模糊的人影，部分被侧边裁掉。右下前景，一面小旗斜向上扬。它的浅色条纹与点状星区在黑白中仍可辨，成为柔软背景人脸前一块清楚的图案。旗杆与手若存在，也在裁切外或暗处难辨，因此小旗主要呈现为折叠布面。右上方窄小的亮区暗示人群身后的户外日光；其余场景拥挤而阴暗。光不均匀地落在最近的脸上，照亮鼻梁中央和面颊，帽子、嘴角以及人群间隙则留暗。浅焦、粗颗粒、高反差、突然截断的画边与未经摆拍的表情，使图像具有迅速直接的纪实感。没有其他可读标志或文字。整体构图把一张脸推向观者，再以重复的模糊面孔和清楚的旗帜图案平衡。
style_prompt_en: A direct black-and-white documentary photograph favors abrupt close cropping, coarse grain, and uneven natural light. The nearest form carries crisp pores and dark facial detail, while successive forms fall rapidly out of focus into soft gray masses. Hard local contrasts appear against broad shaded passages, and a small sharp patterned accent can punctuate the blurred surroundings. The frame feels crowded because edges cut through forms and leave little neutral space; depth comes from focus falloff and overlapping silhouettes. Tonal whites are slightly dirty rather than polished, while blacks remain dense and tactile. The overall effect is immediate, candid, and visually tense, with imperfection and off-center balance giving the photograph its character.
style_prompt_zh: 这种直接的黑白纪实摄影偏好突然逼近的裁切、粗颗粒与不均匀自然光。最近的形体保留清楚的毛孔和深色细节，连续后退的形体迅速失焦，化成柔软灰块。坚硬的局部反差嵌在宽阔阴影中，一块小而清楚的图案强调可以点破模糊环境。画幅显得拥挤，因为边缘截断形体，几乎没有中性空地；纵深来自焦点衰减和剪影遮叠。白调略带污感而非精修，黑色则浓密可触。整体效果即时、抓拍而视觉紧张，瑕疵与偏心平衡赋予照片个性。
theme_en: A close cropped face beside a small American flag with blurred people behind
theme_zh: 一张紧贴画边的人脸旁有一面小美国旗，身后人群模糊
name: Robert Frank
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
